schema.name: currency
schema.description: Retrieve exchange rates for multiple currencies based on a specific currency.

base_currency.description: The base currency, needs English lowercase. Default: 'cny'

exchange_currencies.description: Currency names for which exchange rates need to be retrieved, English lowercase. Multiple currencies separated by |. Default: 'usd|try|ngn'

prompt: Refine the results and calculate the accurate data.
